name: qa-engineering
description: The single AI QA engineering plugin: one orchestrator for the whole loop — analyze a story or a module, author and approve test cases, build and generate API + UI automation, run the suite, and turn a failing run into a bug — human-gated at every tracker write. Publishing cases to a Test Plan/Suite and filing bugs support Azure DevOps today (other trackers planned); every other workflow is tracker-independent and works with no tracker at all. Also teaches and reviews a Playwright + TypeScript framework. Self-contained with its own native QA skills; ships no product data — the QA supplies tracker, API, auth and URLs locally through a git-ignored house-profile and .env.
